name: Society of Biological Psychiatry 82nd Annual Meeting 2027
description: The 2027 SOBP Annual Meeting takes place May 6 to 8, 2027, in Chicago under the theme The Metabolic Brain. Travel fellowship applications for the meeting close October 5, 2026; the oral and poster abstract deadline has not been posted on the society site as of September 2026.
